title: services.packages.grants params
description: Vouchers SOLD of one catalogue voucher (services#82): one row per customer purchase, live or voided, with sessions used and remaining, expiry and, if voided, who, when and why. It is a PAGINATED query: the list engine vocabulary (limit/offset/sort/dir/search and the f_<column> filters) travels in the same payload, which is why the schema stays OPEN. The hub_id scope is injected by the runtime (§2.5).

package_id.description: Id of the catalogue voucher whose sales are listed.
